title: Predator-Prey Boids Avoidance Simulation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with an interactive 3D predator-prey boids avoidance simulation using Three.js and GLTFLoader (from CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/build/three.module.js and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js).

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a scene with a dark blue-gray background (0x1a1a2e).
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 40, 60) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light at (20, 40, 20) with intensity 1.0 and castShadow enabled.
- Create a flat ground plane (100x100) with a semi-transparent grid material at y=0.
- The simulation arena is bounded: x in [-45, 45], z in [-45, 45], y in [1, 20].

MODELS:
- Load 'GlassHurricaneCandleHolder.glb' as the PREY boid model. Scale each instance to (0.8, 0.8, 0.8). Spawn 15 prey boids at random positions within the arena bounds. These represent the flock.
- Load 'DamagedHelmet.glb' as the PREDATOR model. Scale to (1.5, 1.5, 1.5). Spawn 2 predators at random positions within the arena.
- Clone the loaded GLTF scenes for each boid/predator instance.

BOIDS BEHAVIOR (prey):
- Implement classic boids rules for the 15 prey agents:
  1. SEPARATION: steer away from nearby prey within radius 5 units (weight 1.5)
  2. ALIGNMENT: match velocity of nearby prey within radius 10 units (weight 1.0)
  3. COHESION: steer toward center of nearby prey within radius 10 units (weight 1.0)
  4. AVOIDANCE: steer away from predators within radius 15 units (weight 3.0, highest priority)
  5. BOUNDS: soft boundary steering when within 5 units of arena edge (weight 2.0)
- Max prey speed: 8 units/sec. Max steering force: 0.3 per frame.
- Each prey boid should face its movement direction (rotate model to align with velocity vector).

PREDATOR BEHAVIOR:
- Each predator chases the nearest prey boid.
- Predator max speed: 6 units/sec (slower than prey but persistent).
- Predator steering force: 0.2 per frame.
- When a predator comes within 2.5 units of a prey, that prey is 'caught': remove it from the scene and decrement prey count.
- Predators also respect arena bounds with soft boundary steering.
- Predators face their movement direction.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- SPACEBAR: Toggle pause/resume of the simulation.
- 'R' key: Reset the simulation to initial state (respawn all 15 prey and 2 predators at new random positions, reset all counters).
- 'A' key: Add one new prey boid at a random position within the arena.
- 'P' key: Add one new predator at a random position.
- Mouse click on the ground plane (raycast): Place a 'scare point' (yellow sphere, radius 1) that repels all prey within radius 12 for 5 seconds, then disappears. Max 3 scare points active at once.
- DOM button 'Toggle Trails': Toggle rendering of short trail lines behind each prey boid (last 10 positions). Trails are thin lines colored green for prey.
- DOM slider 'Predator Speed' (range 2-12, step 0.5, default 6): Adjusts predator max speed in real time.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left HUD overlay showing:
  - 'Prey Alive: X' (current count)
  - 'Prey Caught: X' (total caught)
  - 'Predators: X' (current count)
  - 'Sim Time: Xs' (elapsed simulation seconds, paused when paused)
  - 'Status: Running/Paused'
- Bottom-center: the 'Toggle Trails' button and 'Predator Speed' slider with label.

STATE MANAGEMENT:
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - preyCount: number of alive prey
  - preyCaughtCount: number of prey caught by predators
  - predatorCount: number of active predators
  - paused: boolean
  - simTime: elapsed simulation time in seconds (float)
  - trailsEnabled: boolean
  - predatorMaxSpeed: current predator max speed (float)
  - scarePointCount: number of active scare points
  - preyPositions: array of {x, y, z} for each alive prey
  - predatorPositions: array of {x, y, z} for each predator
  - preyVelocities: array of {x, y, z} for each alive prey
  - averagePreySpeed: average speed magnitude of all alive prey (float)
  - totalBoidsEver: total prey ever spawned (initial 15 + added)
  - sceneReady: true once models loaded and simulation initialized
  - resetCount: number of times reset has been triggered (starts 0)

ANIMATION:
- Use requestAnimationFrame with delta time clamped to max 0.05s.
- Update all boid physics each frame when not paused.
- Ensure smooth 60fps target.

PHYSICS CONSTRAINTS:
- All positions must remain within arena bounds [-45,45] x [1,20] x [-45,45].
- No velocity should ever be NaN or Infinity.
- Speed must never exceed max speed for each agent type.
- preyCount + preyCaughtCount must always equal totalBoidsEver.
physics_constraints: Arena bounds: x∈[-45,45], y∈[1,20], z∈[-45,45]. Prey max speed 8 u/s, predator max speed adjustable (default 6). Catch radius 2.5 units. Conservation: preyCount + preyCaughtCount === totalBoidsEver at all times. No NaN/Infinity in any position or velocity. Scare points max 3 concurrent, each lasts 5 seconds.
